parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token from your client to make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each request is unique.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the flow log. The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying the service resource.

- **false** (default): Sends a normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance.

parameters.name: FlowLogId
parameters.description: The ID of the flow log instance.

parameters.name: FlowLogName
parameters.description: The new name of the flow log. The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The aggregation interval for capturing traffic data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- **60**

- **600**

Default value: **600**.

parameters.name: SamplingRate
parameters.description:
The sampling ratio. Valid values:

- **1:4096**

- **1:2048**

- **1:1024**

Default value: **1:4096**.
